title: testLocation
responsibility: Builds the canonical tests address used by regression checkpoint links.

inputs.name: testLocation.route
inputs.description: Required current explorer location, retaining branch and the canonical navigation context.

inputs.name: testLocation.entity
inputs.description: Required target entity identity and category, read without mutating the entity.

inputs.name: testLocation.commit
inputs.description: Required recorded regression commit, passed unchanged to the canonical route helper.

outputs.name: testLocation
outputs.description: Canonical explorer location for the same entity and branch, with the selected recorded commit and tests tab.

errors.name: Input access error
errors.description: Errors from supplied property or string-operation access propagate unchanged.
